# Terrain review, 2026-11-06

Follow-up of a code review of the runtime and the terrain engines. Every line says what proves it, or says that nothing does yet. **Open** means not done. Tests named here are in `node/packages/runtime/tests/runtime-review.test.ts` unless stated otherwise, and were seen failing before their fix where marked.

| Subject                               | Status                        | Proof                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Cancellation, then a quick return     | Fixed                         | "loads a tile back once it returns", seen failing first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Cancellation of DEM loads             | Fixed                         | `tests/tile-pyramid.test.ts` of `@spacexr/tiles`: the last request to leave aborts the load after `abortDelayMilliseconds`, a request coming back keeps it, others go on, a request without a signal keeps it. T20: at 500 ms, no repeated request on the paths where aborting at once sent up to 247 more |
| Priorities of queued loads            | Fixed                         | "raises" and "lowers the priority of a queued tile", seen failing first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Implicit materialization              | Fixed                         | "creates no descendant below a tile that satisfies its threshold", seen failing with the fix removed                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Cache stability on a fixed cut        | Fixed                         | "keeps its tile count on a fixed cut", with 64 and with 1 024 leaves under a budget of 4 096, seen failing with the fix removed                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Reset of the coarsening delay         | Fixed                         | "starts again when the refinement is required again", seen failing first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Coarsening delay in time              | Fixed                         | `coarseningDelayMilliseconds`, "asks for a frame when it expires", seen failing first. A delay that was counted in frames is gone                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Rotation looking straight down        | Fixed                         | `tests/motion-refinement.test.ts` of Babylon, on the speed computed from the poses. The Q/E keys, the right button and touch were not run                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Resuming after a stop                 | Measured                      | T18: no gap and no hole at rest on 18 runs, 0.3 to 2.7 s after the end of the path                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Balance and counters                  | Fixed                         | "counts changes of the frame": `tile.refine` and `tile.coarsen` count frames, `tile.*.attempt` the passes, `cut.entered` and `cut.left` the cut                                                                                                                                                            |
| Cover of the body                     | **Open**                      | Step 4 of the plan: its instances are not bounded and its loads leave the scheduler                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| GPU geometry contract, no XYZ texture | **Open**                      | Step 2 of the plan. The textures are still there                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Saturation of GPU resources           | **Open**                      | Goes with step 2. A shape pool that fills up still falls back on layer 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Old meshes across faces               | Fixed                         | `tests/displayed-tiles.test.ts` of Babylon, "keeps a ghost when a tile with the same address appears on another face"                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Normals at the poles                  | **Partly**                    | `tests/cube-terrain.test.ts` of Babylon, on a sphere: under 0.01 degree. Not tested on a continuous DEM under grazing light                                                                                                                                                                                |
| First build of a mesh                 | Fixed                         | `tests/geodesic-grid-pipeline.test.ts` of Babylon, "builds a new tile once", seen failing with the fix removed                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Budget of mesh junctions              | Fixed                         | `tests/geodesic-grid-pipeline.test.ts` of Babylon, "counts the scan of the tiles in its budget", seen failing with the fix removed                                                                                                                                                                         |
| GPU uploads                           | **Open**                      | Step 4. The whole instance buffer is still sent when one tile changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| GPU seam probe                        | Fixed                         | It follows the grid drawn and compares positions, and adds 100 m to one shared vertex at each integrity pass: `probeDetects` reads true. It compares double precision positions, not the floats of the shader                                                                                              |
| Junctions, faces and corners          | GPU: measured. Mesh: **open** | T18: 0 m in the view on the 9 GPU paths with the corrected probe, including face edges, a vertex of the cube and the pole. The mesh engine shows up to 361 m in motion, 0 at rest                                                                                                                          |
| Geometric error of Mercator           | Fixed                         | `tests/tile-data-source.test.ts`: the error is the size of the largest cell at its row. Equal quality at several latitudes is not measured                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Horizon and vertical scale            | Fixed                         | `tests/vertical-scale.test.ts`, "reads the same lowest terrain as a fresh metric"                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Bounds of triaxial surfaces           | **Open**                      | Not looked at. No case on the Moon                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

## To close

| Subject               | Status                 | Proof                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Automated regressions | Done for what is fixed | The tests above, and `npm run check` to rerun once this review is finished                                                                                                                                                    |
| Reproducible campaign | **Partly**             | T18: both projections, both engines, all paths, one run. Cold and warm caches, and a quick return, are not separate paths yet                                                                                                 |
| Complete results      | **Partly**             | T18 and T19 report the median, p95 and p99 of frame times, changes of the cut and cancelled loads. One run of each, except T17                                                                                                |
| Visual validation     | **Partly**             | T19: images at rest after a path, with and without following the speed, at one exact pose per path: at most 0.42 % of pixels above 8 / 255. Without imagery only. Images in motion and against a fresh page were not compared |

## Measurements before this review

The GPU seam figures of the test log are only valid at grids of 16 cells. At other sizes the probe read 33 points of 129 on an edge and applied the rule of midpoints at the wrong pitch. See entry T18.
